# Hotel Kotva — Sunny Beach, Bulgaria

> Four-star family All Inclusive hotel in the southern part of Sunny Beach,
> Bulgaria, built around its own aquapark: 22 waterslides across three
> connected pools, plus a half-Olympic swimming pool and a children's pool
> with a wooden pirate ship. The aquapark is free of charge for hotel guests.
> 250 m from the beach, 1.5 km from the UNESCO town of Nessebar.

## Key facts

- Name: Hotel Kotva (Хотел Котва), 4 stars
- Address: southern Sunny Beach, 8240 Sunny Beach, Burgas, Bulgaria
- Coordinates: 42.667139, 27.708333
- Phone: +359 554 22422 · +359 88 7973568
- Capacity: 320 rooms and 151 apartments (471 units), two connected
  four-storey buildings with lifts
- Room categories: Double Room 18 m² (1–4 guests), One-Bedroom Suite 38 m²
  (1–5 guests), Economy Double Room 16 m² (1–3 guests)
- Aquapark: 22 waterslides over three connected pools, INCLUDED free of
  charge for hotel guests — no ticket, no day pass, no per-person fee
- Pools: 4 outdoor pools in total — 3 aquapark pools plus a half-Olympic
  swimming pool of 25 m × 12.5 m; a shallow children's pool is built around
  a wooden pirate ship with its own small slides
- Board: All Inclusive — begins with lunch on the arrival day (after 10:30)
  and ends with breakfast on the departure day
- Food and drink: buffet restaurant, Bistro "Black Pearl", pool bar,
  lobby bar; local alcoholic and soft drinks included
- Other facilities: fitness room, massage (extra charge), games room with
  billiards and table tennis (extra charge), doctor's office, animation
  programme, free Wi-Fi, 24/7 reception, garden playground
- Distances: beach 250 m (~4 min walk); old Nessebar (UNESCO) 1.5 km;
  centre of Sunny Beach ~3 km; Burgas Airport ~30 km
- Guest rating: 7.9/10 ("Good") from 95 Booking.com reviews; guests most
  often single out the aquapark, the food and the family atmosphere
- Check-in 15:00, check-out 11:00
- Parking on site: €12 per day. Pets up to 7 kg: €10 per day
- Booking: direct on this website — live price by dates and guests, best
  price guarantee against any booking site
